name: bicepflex
description: Standalone, configurable Bicep and Bicep parameters formatter backed by the Bicep compiler.

bicepFlex.preset.description: Choose a formatting policy. "opinionated" — use dependency-aware ordering; "minimal" — avoid optional declaration and property reordering. Default: "opinionated".
enumDescriptions: Use dependency-aware ordering and the standard layout.
Avoid optional declaration, property, and decorator reordering.

bicepFlex.bicepObjectLayout.description: Layout of nonempty objects and object types. Choices: "multiline" — expand nonempty objects and object types; "auto" — keep compact source objects on one line when they fit; "preserve" — retain the author's compact or expanded layout even beyond the width target when safe. Default: "multiline".
enumDescriptions: expand nonempty objects and object types
keep compact source objects on one line when they fit
retain the author's compact or expanded layout even beyond the width target when safe

bicepFlex.bicepArrayLayout.description: Layout of arrays containing only primitive literals. Choices: "compact" — fit arrays of primitive literals on one line; "multiline" — expand arrays of primitive literals; "preserve" — retain the source layout even beyond the width target when safe. Default: "compact".
enumDescriptions: fit arrays of primitive literals on one line
expand arrays of primitive literals
retain the source layout even beyond the width target when safe

bicepFlex.bicepPrintWidth.description: Bicep-only wrapping target. When omitted, inherit printWidth. Default: 180 in the Settings UI; when unset, inherits printWidth.

bicepFlex.bicepTabWidth.description: Bicep-only indentation width. When omitted, inherit tabWidth. Default: 2 in the Settings UI; when unset, inherits tabWidth.

bicepFlex.bicepIndentStyle.description: Bicep-only indentation style; inherit follows useTabs. Choices: "inherit" — follow useTabs; "spaces" — indent with spaces; "tabs" — indent with tabs. Default: "inherit".
enumDescriptions: follow useTabs
indent with spaces
indent with tabs

bicepFlex.printWidth.description: Wrapping target for Bicep files when bicepPrintWidth is not set. Default: 180.

bicepFlex.tabWidth.description: Indentation width for Bicep files when bicepTabWidth is not set. Default: 2.

bicepFlex.useTabs.description: Use tabs for indentation when bicepIndentStyle is inherit. Default: false.

enumDescriptions: preserve the detected line ending convention
use LF line endings
use CRLF line endings
use CR line endings
bicepFlex.endOfLine.description: Line ending convention for formatted Bicep files. Choices: "auto" — preserve the detected line ending convention; "lf" — use LF line endings; "crlf" — use CRLF line endings; "cr" — use CR line endings. Default: "auto".

bicepFlex.bicepDeclarationSpacing.description: Spacing between declarations. Choices: "separate" — insert one blank line between declarations; "compact" — remove blank lines between declarations; "preserve" — retain author spacing where safe. Default: "separate".
enumDescriptions: insert one blank line between declarations
remove blank lines between declarations
retain author spacing where safe

bicepFlex.bicepParameterSpacing.description: Spacing between consecutive Bicep parameter declarations. Choices: "description" — group plain parameters and separate any parameter with @description; "inherit" — follow bicepDeclarationSpacing for every parameter; "preserve" — retain author blank lines between consecutive parameters where safe. Default: "description".
enumDescriptions: group plain parameters and separate any parameter with @description
follow bicepDeclarationSpacing for every parameter
retain author blank lines between consecutive parameters where safe

bicepFlex.bicepPropertyBlankLines.description: Preserve author blank lines between object properties. Default: false.

bicepFlex.bicepSortDeclarations.description: Apply section and dependency-aware declaration ordering. Default: true.

bicepFlex.bicepDeclarationOrder.description: Declaration section priorities, listed from first to last. Default: ["metadata","extension","targetScope","import","type","param","func","var","resource","module","output"].

bicepFlex.bicepSortProperties.description: Order immediate resource and module body properties. Default: true.

bicepFlex.bicepResourcePropertyOrder.description: Resource property priorities; * marks unlisted properties. Default: ["name","parent","scope","location","dependsOn","tags","identity","kind","sku","zones","plan","*","properties"].

bicepFlex.bicepModulePropertyOrder.description: Module property priorities; * marks unlisted properties. Default: ["name","scope","dependsOn","*","params"].

bicepFlex.bicepSortDecorators.description: Order recognized built-in decorators. Default: true.

bicepFlex.bicepVariablePlacement.description: Place variables before first use, in the variable section, or in dependency-safe source order. Choices: "first-use" — place used variables before their first consumer; "section" — keep variables in the configured variable section; "preserve" — keep variables in author order when dependencies allow. Default: "first-use".
enumDescriptions: place used variables before their first consumer
keep variables in the configured variable section
keep variables in author order when dependencies allow

bicepFlex.bicepExistingResourcePlacement.description: Place existing resources before first use or retain their sequence position. Choices: "first-use" — place used existing resources before first use; "preserve" — retain their position in dependency-safe resource order. Default: "first-use".
enumDescriptions: place used existing resources before first use
retain their position in dependency-safe resource order

bicepFlex.bicepOutputPlacement.description: Place resource/module outputs after dependencies, at the end, or in dependency-safe source order. Choices: "dependency" — place resource/module outputs after their dependencies; "end" — leave outputs in the configured output section; "preserve" — keep outputs in author order when dependencies allow. Default: "dependency".
enumDescriptions: place resource/module outputs after their dependencies
leave outputs in the configured output section
keep outputs in author order when dependencies allow

bicepFlex.bicepOutputOnlyVariables.description: Place output-only variables and outputs at the end, by dependency, or in dependency-safe source order. Choices: "end" — keep output-only variables with outputs at the end; "dependency" — allow placement next to their dependencies; "preserve" — keep output-only helpers and outputs in author order when dependencies allow. Default: "end".
enumDescriptions: keep output-only variables with outputs at the end
allow placement next to their dependencies
keep output-only helpers and outputs in author order when dependencies allow

bicepFlex.bicepResourceModuleOrder.description: Combine resources/modules into one section or use their separate declaration priorities. Choices: "combined" — place resources and modules in one section; "separate" — respect their separate section priorities. Default: "combined".
enumDescriptions: place resources and modules in one section
respect their separate section priorities

bicepFlex.bicepTypeOrder.description: Order types relative to their referenced types. Choices: "dependents-first" — put referencing types first; "dependencies-first" — put referenced types first; "preserve" — retain source order within the type section. Default: "dependents-first".
enumDescriptions: put referencing types first
put referenced types first
retain source order within the type section

bicepFlex.bicepFunctionOrder.description: Order functions relative to called functions. Choices: "dependencies-first" — put called functions before callers; "dependents-first" — put callers before called functions; "preserve" — retain source order within the function section. Default: "dependencies-first".
enumDescriptions: put called functions before callers
put callers before called functions
retain source order within the function section

bicepFlex.bicepNestedResources.description: Place nested resource declarations after properties or preserve their positions. Choices: "last" — place nested resources after ordinary properties; "preserve" — keep them as boundaries between property sections. Default: "last".
enumDescriptions: place nested resources after ordinary properties
keep them as boundaries between property sections

bicepFlex.bicepImportSpacing.description: Spacing between consecutive imports; inherit follows declaration spacing. Choices: "compact" — remove blank lines between imports; "separate" — insert a blank line between imports; "preserve" — retain author spacing; "inherit" — follow declaration spacing. Default: "compact".
enumDescriptions: remove blank lines between imports
insert a blank line between imports
retain author spacing
follow declaration spacing

bicepFlex.bicepUnionLayout.description: Keep unions width-aware, multiline, or in their authored member layout. Choices: "auto" — keep short unions inline and wrap long ones; "multiline" — put each union member on a separate line; "preserve" — keep source union layout even beyond width when safe. Default: "auto".
enumDescriptions: keep short unions inline and wrap long ones
put each union member on a separate line
keep source union layout even beyond width when safe

bicepFlex.bicepConditionalHeader.description: Keep direct resource/module if conditions compact and move long headers, or choose legacy placement. Choices: "compact" — keep direct if conditions on one line and move a long header below =; "inline" — keep direct resource/module if headers inline; "auto" — move if to the next line only when the header exceeds width; "next-line" — always put if on the next line; "preserve" — retain the author's inline or next-line direct if placement. Default: "compact".
enumDescriptions: keep direct if conditions on one line and move a long header below =
keep direct resource/module if headers inline
move if to the next line only when the header exceeds width
always put if on the next line
retain the author's inline or next-line direct if placement

bicepFlex.bicepIfConditionLayout.description: Keep if-condition calls and conditional loop headers inline, width-aware, or authored. Choices: "inline" — keep if-condition calls inline and compact conditional object-loop headers regardless of width; "wrap" — wrap calls and conditional object-loop headers to the width target; "preserve" — retain authored if-condition calls and conditional loop headers even beyond width. Default: "inline".
enumDescriptions: keep if-condition calls inline and compact conditional object-loop headers regardless of width
wrap calls and conditional object-loop headers to the width target
retain authored if-condition calls and conditional loop headers even beyond width

bicepFlex.bicepLogicalCallLayout.description: Keep calls under && or || inline, width-aware, or in their authored layout. Choices: "inline" — keep calls under && and || on one line; "wrap" — wrap call arguments under logical operators to the width target; "preserve" — retain authored call layout under logical operators even beyond width. Default: "inline".
enumDescriptions: keep calls under && and || on one line
wrap call arguments under logical operators to the width target
retain authored call layout under logical operators even beyond width

bicepFlex.bicepLoopLayout.description: Compact fitting object-loop brackets, expand them, or retain authored shape. Choices: "auto" — compact object-loop headers when they fit; "expanded" — retain expanded native brackets; "preserve" — retain authored compact or expanded object-loop brackets even beyond width. Default: "auto".
enumDescriptions: compact object-loop headers when they fit
retain expanded native brackets
retain authored compact or expanded object-loop brackets even beyond width

bicepFlex.bicepQuoteProperties.description: Quoting of plain identifier property names. Choices: "as-needed" — remove optional quotes around identifier keys; "preserve" — retain source quoting. Default: "as-needed".
enumDescriptions: remove optional quotes around identifier keys
retain source quoting

bicepFlex.bicepLambdaParentheses.description: Parentheses for single-parameter lambdas. Choices: "avoid" — omit optional parentheses around one lambda parameter; "always" — add parentheses around one lambda parameter; "preserve" — retain the source choice. Default: "avoid".
enumDescriptions: omit optional parentheses around one lambda parameter
add parentheses around one lambda parameter
retain the source choice

bicepFlex.bicepDescriptionWidth.description: Whether description decorators respect the width target. Choices: "ignore" — leave descriptions inline regardless of width; "wrap" — wrap long description calls without reflowing their strings; "preserve" — retain the author's inline or multiline description layout even beyond width. Default: "ignore".
enumDescriptions: leave descriptions inline regardless of width
wrap long description calls without reflowing their strings
retain the author's inline or multiline description layout even beyond width

bicepFlex.bicepDependencyOrder.description: Resolve dependency ties by earliest readiness, proximity to consumers, or dependency-safe source order. Choices: "ready-first" — choose the earliest currently ready declaration; "dependencies-first" — pull prerequisites before the earliest consumer; "preserve" — keep dependency-safe declarations in author order instead of section order. Default: "ready-first".
enumDescriptions: choose the earliest currently ready declaration
pull prerequisites before the earliest consumer
keep dependency-safe declarations in author order instead of section order

bicepFlex.bicepUnusedDeclarations.description: Keep unused variables/existing resources fixed or allow section ordering. Choices: "boundary" — keep unused variables and existing resources in place; "section" — allow them to move within their sections. Default: "boundary".
enumDescriptions: keep unused variables and existing resources in place
allow them to move within their sections

bicepFlex.bicepSectionComments.description: Keep blank-line-separated headings fixed or move them with the following declaration. Choices: "boundary" — keep blank-line-separated headings in place; "attached" — move headings with the next declaration. Default: "boundary".
enumDescriptions: keep blank-line-separated headings in place
move headings with the next declaration

bicepFlex.bicepIgnoredDeclarations.description: Allow ignored declarations to move without changing their text, or fix their position. Choices: "move" — allow ignored declarations to move without changing their text; "boundary" — keep ignored declarations in place. Default: "move".
enumDescriptions: allow ignored declarations to move without changing their text
keep ignored declarations in place

bicepFlex.bicepImportMemberOrder.description: Keep imported symbol order or sort by the original imported name. Choices: "preserve" — retain imported symbol order; "alphabetical" — sort by original imported name. Default: "preserve".
enumDescriptions: retain imported symbol order
sort by original imported name

bicepFlex.bicepTypeMemberOrder.description: Keep object-type property order or put required properties before nullable/optional properties. Choices: "preserve" — retain object-type member order; "required-first" — place syntactically nullable members last. Default: "preserve".
enumDescriptions: retain object-type member order
place syntactically nullable members last
